integrity: Exact integer simplicial Smith computations over all 52 graph-isomorphism types and a separately reconstructed 65-pair acyclic discrete-Morse certificate with integral attaching degrees; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness only among bidirected loopless simple undirected graphs of order at most five; the example has a projective-plane wedge summand but is not claimed to realize the projective plane alone; no larger-order or nonsymmetric classification; originality subject to incomplete bibliographic coverage.
title: A five-vertex projective-plane threshold for symmetric-digraph multipath complexes
